claim_ceiling: Dense center-projected embeddings achieve JP <= 0.42 at all scales tested (3yr-165k); they do not pass jurist pairwise preference gate and are not suitable as primary navigation mode. Validated complementary modes: citation heritage recovery (AUC 0.79-0.85), sachverhalt cross-lingual alignment (0.282), linear hybrid complement (JP 0.61-0.67 at 22yr).
evidence_summary: 165k dense formal suite evaluation (cycle 37148054426) independently verified. Three center-projected variants (768/64/128-dim) tested on 165,463 decisions against formal adversarial suite. All FAIL jurist pairwise preference (JP=0.389-0.418 < 0.5 threshold). Language dominance PASS (0.83-0.85) is a boilerplate artifact (boilerplate neighbor rate 94-95%, cross-lang recall@10 0.04). Full corpus: only temporal stability PASS (0.78). Hierarchy coherence FAIL (L1 NMI 0.35-0.37). Cross-language transfer shows negative gap but absolute NMI near noise floor (0.22-0.24). Results consistent with 22yr/144k evaluation (JP=0.4265). No defects found. Honest negative result correctly reported.
